name: E02_2_crossway_troublemakers_a_vampire_that_is_not_attacking_has_neither
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink.' Seat 0's Vampire (1/1) is not attacking; it deals 1 damage to seat 1's 0/9 Wall (an effect, outside combat). With no deathtouch the Wall survives with 1 damage marked, and with no lifelink seat 0 gains nothing: 20.
